name: softmax_unstable
summary: CONTROL: row softmax with the max subtraction omitted in every entrant (y = exp(x) / sum(exp(x))); inputs in [80,100] overflow f32 exp (e^100 = 2.69e43 > f32 max 3.40e38), so every entrant must fail against the stable softmax reference

y.why: same contract as workloads/softmax (reference_from softmax). Expected to fail: without the max subtraction exp overflows f32 for x > ln(f32 max) (WolframLanguageEvaluator: Log[(2-2^-23) 2^127] -> 88.7228; Exp[100] -> 2.6881e43 > (2-2^-23)2^127 = 3.4028e38), so row sums are +inf and the outputs NaN or 0.
